standard.summary: 根据梯度信噪比（GSNR）自动调整学习率，追踪训练健康指标实现更精确的控制。
standard.effect: 当 GSNR 偏离目标时，按 ac_auto_lr_scale_factor 调整 LR，以保持梯度质量在期望范围内。
standard.whenToUse: 对训练质量要求高、有充足调参经验时开启。需要配合 ac_target_gsnr 设置合理目标值。
standard.avoidWhen: 初学者不建议开启，GSNR 目标设置不当会导致 LR 反复剧烈波动。

standard_en.summary: Adjusts the learning rate automatically from the gradient signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR), tracking training-health metrics for finer control.
standard_en.effect: When GSNR deviates from the target, the LR is scaled by ac_auto_lr_scale_factor to keep gradient quality inside the expected range.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you care a lot about training quality and have enough tuning experience. It needs a sensible ac_target_gsnr alongside it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not recommended for beginners: a badly chosen GSNR target makes the LR swing violently back and forth.

advanced.principle: GSNR = (mean_grad / std_grad)²，反映梯度信号质量。GSNR 过低（梯度噪声大）→ 降 LR；过高（梯度过于集中）→ 可适当提高 LR。
advanced.tradeoffs: 计算 GSNR 需要对所有参数梯度做统计，额外开销约 5~10%；目标值需要根据具体模型和数据集调整。

advanced_en.principle: GSNR = (mean_grad / std_grad)², reflecting gradient signal quality. GSNR too low (noisy gradients) → lower LR; too high (gradients overly concentrated) → LR can be raised somewhat.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Computing GSNR requires statistics over all parameter gradients, roughly 5~10% overhead; the target value needs tuning per model and dataset.
